brief:
Compose a "face of the evidence" — one public chain root chosen per vertex of the 64-vertex lattice, each root sitting at the vertex its own first six bits name — and fold it into a portable key (City Key) as an additive chains field with a sidecar, so the key's content address moves and its prior chain records the new step of the bearer's trajectory. Use when gathering many evidence chains onto one lattice, letting a person compose their own reading of them, or carrying chosen work roots inside an identity carrier without carrying the work.

Many chains, one lattice. A root's vertex is its first six bits, read in the lattice's own order (most significant first), so placement needs no table and every surface agrees. A face is a choice of one root per vertex; folding it into the bearer's key appends a workflow hash chain to their trajectory.

- Several evidence chains should be seen together on the 64 states. - A person wants to compose and keep their own selection of public work roots. - A key carrier needs to name chosen evidence without holding it.
